entries.title: Psalms 94:1
segments: ¶O LORD God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself. {God...: Heb. God of revenges} {shew...: Heb. shine forth}

words.text: thyself. {God...: Heb. God of revenges} {shew...: Heb. shine forth}

entries.title: Psalms 94:2
segments: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.

entries.title: Psalms 94:3
segments: LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?

entries.title: Psalms 94:4
segments: [How long] shall they utter [and] speak hard things? [and] all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?

entries.title: Psalms 94:5
segments: They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.

entries.title: Psalms 94:6
segments: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.

entries.title: Psalms 94:7
segments: Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard [it].

entries.title: Psalms 94:8
segments: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and [ye] fools, when will ye be wise?

entries.title: Psalms 94:9
segments: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?

entries.title: Psalms 94:10
segments: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, [shall not he know]?

entries.title: Psalms 94:11
segments: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they [are] vanity.

entries.title: Psalms 94:12
segments: ¶Blessed [is] the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD, and teachest him out of thy law;

entries.title: Psalms 94:13
segments: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.

words.text: That thou mayest give him rest

entries.title: Psalms 94:14
segments: For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 94:15
segments: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it. {shall follow...: Heb. shall be after it}

words.text: it. {shall follow...: Heb. shall be after it}

entries.title: Psalms 94:16
segments: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? [or] who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

entries.title: Psalms 94:17
segments: Unless the LORD [had been] my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence. {almost: or, quickly}

entries.title: Psalms 94:18
segments: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.

entries.title: Psalms 94:19
segments: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 94:20
segments: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?

entries.title: Psalms 94:21
segments: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

entries.title: Psalms 94:22
segments: But the LORD is my defence; and my God [is] the rock of my refuge.

entries.title: Psalms 94:23
segments: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; [yea], the LORD our God shall cut them off.
